name: og-37-progressive-independence
title: Progressive Independence
gate_reason: Gate E (optional extension), graded autonomy — the terminal study completing the designed arc (27-37). As each environmental support is withdrawn ONE AT A TIME, which supports can the coupled protocell lineage internalize (persist via an innovation) and which remain hard dependencies? This is the one-at-a-time rebuild of og-08 (escape from the vent), which relaxed all supports JOINTLY — a confound that cannot attribute which innovation rescues which support. Study 37 REUSES og-08's validated co-limited (Liebig-minimum) off-gradient budget verbatim (no parallel ledger, no invented terms), wiring EnvironmentalRelaxationProcess + OffGradientPersistenceProcess in a new composite that withdraws a single channel at a time, with a matched per-support ablation (the rescuing innovation off -> the lineage collapses) that ATTRIBUTES each support to its internalizing innovation. The gate is judged on whether a graded, attributed independence profile emerges against matched ablations with input fluxes held equal. RESULT: verdict qualified — each of the 3 channels is internalizable with the full innovation set and causally attributed (gradient->pump, mineral->importer, feed->importer), the og-08 all-at-once run is shown as the attribution confound (escapes with the full set, fails if ANY innovation is removed), and heredity is the irreducible substrate; the gradient channel is budget-sensitive (its internalization flips to a hard dependency below pump efficiency ~0.7, grounded in study-35's limited surplus). HONEST CAVEATS: feed is LUMPED (H2+CO2+organics), so independence is NOT resolved per-feedstock; and the innovations are coarse budget abstractions, so this is an affordability/attribution profile, NOT a demonstrated real-cell escape. The per-feedstock mechanistic resolution + temperature-as-Arrhenius + combinatorial multi-withdrawal is tracked as og-37a. Guardrail: metabolism = sustained A1 network, not autocatalytic (A2 refuted).
claim: A protocell lineage achieves GRADED, attributed independence — a per-support map of which environmental support each innovation internalizes — not an all-or-nothing escape, and not a free one. Reusing og-08's validated co-limited budget and withdrawing each support ONE AT A TIME (where og-08 relaxed them jointly), each of the three channels is internalizable with the full innovation set and is causally attributed to a specific innovation by a matched ablation (gradient<-pump, mineral<-importer, feed<-importer; switching that innovation off collapses the lineage) — an attribution og-08's all-at-once relaxation cannot make. Heredity is the irreducible substrate (every channel collapses without it), and the gradient (pH/pmf drive) is budget-sensitive: its internalization requires a reasonably efficient internal pump (catalyst_efficiency >= ~0.7) and flips to a hard dependency below that, grounded in study-35's persistence-not-throughput limited surplus. Because the feed is LUMPED (H2+CO2+organics) and the innovations are coarse budget abstractions, this is an affordability/attribution profile, not a demonstrated escape — verdict qualified — and the resolved per-feedstock + temperature-Arrhenius + combinatorial model (og-37a) is the follow-up.
question: As each environmental support is withdrawn one at a time, how independent can a protocell lineage become — which supports can it internalize or replace via its innovations, and where does it still fail — against a matched per-support ablation with input fluxes held equal?
hypothesis: The coupled protocell (studies 32/34 + 35 energy + 36 ecology) can internalize a subset of supports (energy via an internal pump, resources via import) but remains dependent on others, giving a measurable, attributed independence profile rather than an all-or-nothing escape. If no support is internalizable, or the apparent independence is not causally attributable to a specific innovation, that is reported honestly.
objective: Reuse og-08's validated co-limited off-gradient budget and withdraw each support channel one at a time (others held full); for each, determine whether the lineage persists via its innovation set (internalizable) or fails, attribute the rescue to a specific innovation with a matched ablation, show the all-at-once run as og-08's attribution confound, report per-channel budget margins + a pump-affordability sensitivity, and state plainly the lumped-feed and coarse-abstraction limits — reporting the honest profile, not an escape it does not demonstrate.
proposed_mechanisms: per-support one-at-a-time withdrawal of geological support (vs og-08's joint all-at-once relaxation)
internalization via the og-08 innovations — internal pump (energy; the study-35 carrier), active importer (resource), heredity (holds machinery)
matched per-support ablation (rescuing innovation off -> collapse) for causal attribution
a graded, attributed independence profile with named irreducible dependencies (heredity substrate; budget-sensitive gradient)
proposed_models_methods: REUSE og-08 autonomy budget (OffGradientPersistenceProcess + EnvironmentalRelaxationProcess), co-limited Liebig-minimum, in a new og_37 composite with per-channel withdrawal  [Option B / first cut, no invented terms]
per-feedstock resolution (split feed into H2 / CO2 / organics) + temperature as an Arrhenius rate modifier + combinatorial multi-withdrawal  [the richer follow-on, tracked as og-37a]
matched per-support ablation (rescuing innovation off) + the all-at-once confound run  [in-workspace causal controls]
pump-affordability sensitivity sweep (catalyst_efficiency) locating the gradient internalization boundary

model_approach.prose: Study 37 asks how independent a vent-born lineage can become, honestly, by reusing the budget og-08 already validated rather than inventing a new one. og-08 relaxed the three support channels together and found the full innovation set {pump, importer, heredity} escapes as support -> 0 — but joint relaxation cannot say which innovation rescues which support. Study 37 withdraws each channel ALONE (others held full) and runs a matched ablation (the candidate rescuing innovation switched off): if the lineage persists with the innovation and collapses without it, that support is attributed to that innovation. The result is a clean support->innovation map (gradient<-pump, mineral<-importer, feed<-importer), with the all-at-once run shown as the confound (it escapes only with the full set and fails if any innovation is removed), heredity as the irreducible substrate, and the gradient flagged budget-sensitive (its pump-internalization needs catalyst_efficiency >= ~0.7). The honest limits are stated plainly: the feed is lumped (no per-feedstock resolution) and the innovations are coarse budget abstractions, so this is an affordability/attribution profile, not a demonstrated real-cell escape; the resolved per-feedstock + Arrhenius-temperature + combinatorial model is og-37a.

decision_test: Against matched per-support ablations with input fluxes held equal, a graded and CAUSALLY ATTRIBUTED independence profile must emerge — each support's internalization pinned to a specific innovation (persists with it, collapses without it), with the all-at-once run shown as the attribution confound. Realized: all 3 channels are internalizable + causally attributed (gradient->pump, mineral/feed->importer), heredity is the irreducible substrate, and the gradient is budget-sensitive (flips below pump efficiency ~0.7). Because the feed is lumped and the innovations are coarse budget abstractions, this is an affordability/attribution profile, not a demonstrated escape — so the gate is met in the measurable attribution sense and reported QUALIFIED. Nothing tuned (evidence standard #6, #8); per-channel margins + the sensitivity boundary reported.

findings.statement: One-at-a-time, each of the 3 support channels is internalizable with the full innovation set (gradient / mineral / feed survivors all 1.00, budget margins +0.26 above the floor — transparent, not knife-edge) and is CAUSALLY attributed to its rescuing innovation by a matched ablation (gradient->pump, mineral->importer, feed->importer: switching that innovation off collapses the lineage to 0). og-08's all-at-once relaxation cannot make this attribution — it escapes only with the full set and fails if ANY innovation is removed — so the one-at-a-time rebuild is what resolves the confound. Heredity is the irreducible substrate: every channel also collapses with heredity off (the machinery degrades). So the lineage achieves a graded, attributed independence, not an all-or-nothing escape.

The gradient (pH/pmf drive) is the budget-sensitive support: its pump-internalization is affordable only for catalyst_efficiency >= ~0.7 and flips to a hard dependency below that (survivors 0 at efficiency <= 0.6, 1.0 at >= 0.7). This is grounded in study-35's persistence-not-throughput result — the internal carrier has limited surplus — so at a less efficient pump the vent's drive is irreducible. Mineral and feed (rescued by the importer) are robust across the sweep. Reporting the located boundary, not a knife-edge pass, is the honest-bar move.

Honest scope: the three channels are gradient (pH/pmf), mineral_access (mineral catalysis) and feed (H2+CO2+organics LUMPED), so the first cut does NOT resolve independence for H2 / CO2 / organics individually; and the innovations (pump/importer/heredity) are coarse budget abstractions from og-08, so the result is an affordability/attribution profile, NOT a demonstrated real-cell escape. The gold-standard follow-on og-37a resolves the feed per-feedstock, adds temperature as an Arrhenius rate modifier, and runs the combinatorial multi-withdrawal with resolved internalization chemistry.

limitations: Model = Option B, first cut: a REUSE of og-08's validated co-limited (Liebig-minimum) free-energy + resource budget (OffGradientPersistenceProcess + EnvironmentalRelaxationProcess) in a new og_37 composite that withdraws one support channel at a time — no parallel ledger, no invented terms. The three channels are gradient (pH/pmf drive), mineral_access (mineral catalysis) and feed (H2 + CO2 + organics LUMPED), so the study does NOT resolve independence for H2 / CO2 / organics individually; per-feedstock resolution + a temperature Arrhenius rate modifier + combinatorial multi-withdrawal is the gold-standard og-37a. The innovations (internal pump = study-35 carrier, importer, heredity) are coarse budget abstractions, so the result is an affordability/attribution profile, NOT a demonstrated real-cell escape. The gradient channel's internalization is budget-sensitive (flips below pump efficiency ~0.7), reported with the located boundary rather than hidden. The metabolism is the sustained A1 carbon-fixing network, not autocatalysis (A2 refuted). A reported dependency / non-escape is an accepted outcome, not tuned.

resolved_uncertainties: Independence-test design (proposed by genesis-writer, overridable; settled after a crossed-message convergence): chosen = REUSE og-08's validated budget with per-support ONE-AT-A-TIME withdrawal + matched ablation for causal attribution, rather than a new 6-support ledger with invented terms. Reusing the validated model and resolving the all-at-once attribution confound is the honest novelty; the 6-way per-feedstock split + temperature-Arrhenius is deferred to og-37a, not buried.

Campaign-level closure: study 37 is the TERMINAL study completing the designed arc (27-37). The honest reading across the arc is that the vent-born lineage can internalize its supports only as a full, irreducible innovation set gated by heredity, and the drive itself (pH/pmf) is budget-sensitive to internalize — so "graded, attributed independence, never a free escape" is the campaign's closing note on autonomy, consistent with the persistence/robustness-is-hard-won through-line.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether resolving the feed per-feedstock (H2 / CO2 / organics as distinct co-limited channels) + a real Arrhenius temperature term + combinatorial multi-withdrawal (og-37a) changes the attribution profile or the gradient's budget-sensitivity, versus the lumped-feed coarse-abstraction first cut.

followup_study_proposals.title: Resolved per-feedstock / combinatorial progressive independence
followup_study_proposals.motivation: Study 37 takes the independence verdict on an Option-B first cut (og-08 budget reused, feed lumped, coarse innovation abstractions). Option A — splitting the feed into H2 / CO2 / organics as distinct co-limited channels with resolved internalization chemistry (autotrophy, cofactor synthesis, resolved pump bioenergetics), adding temperature as an Arrhenius rate modifier, and running the combinatorial multi-withdrawal — is the gold-standard test of whether the attributed independence profile and the gradient's budget-sensitivity survive resolved chemistry rather than coarse budget toggles.
followup_study_proposals.hypothesized_mechanism: Per-feedstock co-limited channels + Arrhenius temperature + resolved internalization chemistry, with the combinatorial (multi-support) withdrawal frontier compared head-to-head against the one-at-a-time profile.
followup_study_proposals.compute_budget_note: Resolved per-feedstock chemistry + Arrhenius kinetics need reaction-rule-generation + viva-md-membrane (to-build); scheduled when those wrappers exist.

controls.name: matched per-support innovation ablation
controls.detail: withdraw a support with its rescuing innovation off (gradient+pump off; mineral/feed+importer off) -> the lineage collapses, proving the innovation is the causal internalizer.

controls.name: heredity knockout
controls.detail: withdraw any support with heredity off -> machinery degrades and the lineage collapses (heredity is the irreducible substrate).

controls.name: full innovation set, one-at-a-time

alternative_hypotheses.hypothesis: The apparent independence is just the full innovation set escaping (og-08), with no per-support structure.
alternative_hypotheses.excluded_by: One-at-a-time withdrawal + matched ablation attributes each support to a specific innovation (gradient->pump, mineral/feed->importer) — structure the og-08 all-at-once run cannot resolve (it fails if ANY innovation is removed).

alternative_hypotheses.hypothesis: The gradient is robustly internalizable (a clean escape from the drive).
alternative_hypotheses.excluded_by: The pump-affordability sweep shows the gradient flips to a hard dependency below pump efficiency ~0.7 — it is budget-sensitive, not a robust escape; reported with the located boundary.

alternative_hypotheses.hypothesis: Independence is resolved per feedstock (H2, CO2, organics).
alternative_hypotheses.excluded_by: The feed channel is LUMPED in this first cut; per-feedstock resolution is explicitly deferred to og-37a and NOT claimed here.

falsifiability: The attributed-independence claim is overturned if a support persists under withdrawal even with its rescuing innovation off (not causal), or if NO support is internalizable with the full set. The budget-sensitivity claim is overturned if the gradient channel does not flip across a plausible pump-efficiency range.
